items.description: Verify schedule_tasks returns correct ordering for linear dependency chain
items.expected_behavior: Given tasks [fetch_data, clean_data, train_model, evaluate_model] with dependencies forming a chain, function returns [fetch_data, clean_data, train_model, evaluate_model]

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks returns lexicographically sorted order when no dependencies exist
items.expected_behavior: Given tasks [b, a, c] with empty dependencies, function returns [a, b, c]

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks returns empty list for empty inputs
items.expected_behavior: Given empty tasks list and empty dependencies list, function returns []

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks returns single task when only one task provided
items.expected_behavior: Given tasks [task1] with no dependencies, function returns [task1]

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks respects all dependency constraints in output
items.expected_behavior: For every dependency pair (A, B), A appears before B in the returned list

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks returns deterministic output with lexicographic tie-breaking
items.expected_behavior: When multiple tasks are available for execution, the lexicographically smallest is selected first, producing consistent results across multiple calls

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks handles diamond-shaped dependency graph correctly
items.expected_behavior: Given tasks [a, b, c, d] with dependencies [(a, b), (a, c), (b, d), (c, d)], function returns [a, b, c, d] with a first and d last

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks handles multiple independent dependency chains
items.expected_behavior: Given multiple independent chains, function returns valid ordering with lexicographic ordering applied to available tasks at each step

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks includes every task exactly once in output
items.expected_behavior: Every task in the input tasks list appears exactly once in the returned execution order

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks raises ValueError for duplicate task names
items.expected_behavior: Given tasks list with duplicate names, function raises ValueError

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks raises ValueError for dependency referencing unknown task
items.expected_behavior: Given dependency pair where before_task or after_task is not in tasks list, function raises ValueError

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks raises ValueError for circular dependency
items.expected_behavior: Given dependencies that form a cycle (e.g., A→B→C→A), function raises ValueError

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks raises ValueError for self-referential dependency
items.expected_behavior: Given dependency pair (A, A), function raises ValueError

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks raises TypeError when tasks parameter is not a list
items.expected_behavior: Given tasks as tuple, dict, string, or other non-list type, function raises TypeError

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks raises TypeError when dependencies parameter is not a list
items.expected_behavior: Given dependencies as tuple, dict, string, or other non-list type, function raises TypeError

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks raises TypeError when task name is not a string
items.expected_behavior: Given tasks list containing non-string elements (int, None, list), function raises TypeError

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks raises TypeError when dependency is not a pair of strings
items.expected_behavior: Given dependency that is not a 2-tuple of strings (e.g., single string, 3-tuple, tuple with non-strings), function raises TypeError

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks is case-sensitive for task names
items.expected_behavior: Tasks 'Task' and 'task' are treated as distinct tasks

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks does not execute tasks or modify external state
items.expected_behavior: Function returns ordering only without executing tasks, touching files, or modifying global state

items.description: Verify schedule_tasks handles long dependency chains efficiently
items.expected_behavior: Given a long linear chain of dependencies, function returns correct ordering respecting all constraints

summary: The schedule_tasks(tasks: list[str], dependencies: list[tuple[str, str]]) function computes a valid topological ordering of tasks respecting all dependency constraints. It returns a list[str] containing each task exactly once, ordered such that for every dependency pair (A, B), A appears before B, with ties broken lexicographically. The function must reject invalid inputs (non-list types, non-string task names, unknown task references, circular dependencies) with appropriate TypeError or ValueError exceptions, and handle boundary cases including empty inputs, single tasks, and complex dependency graphs like diamond patterns.
